title: Better Exp Storage
description: Added multiple items and blocks for exp storage
body:
# This Mod is a remake of the Exp Storage Book, adding more content.
![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eadcac2f926479c163d61a4b86b7fda915313191.png)

## Exp Storage Book:
### Divided into 5 tiers:
- Exp Storage Book Lv.1: 1000 XP storage capacity
- Exp Storage Book Lv.2: 10000 XP storage capacity
- Exp Storage Book Lv.3: 100000 XP storage capacity
- Exp Storage Book Lv.4: 1000000 XP storage capacity
- Exp Storage Book Lv.999: 100000000 XP storage capacity
### Key:
- Right-click: Store/Withdraw 1 level of experience
- Shift + Right-click: Store/Withdraw all experience
- Shift + Scroll Wheel Up: Switch between Store/Withdraw mode
- Shift + Scroll Wheel Down: Toggle Auto-Store mode
> If the Curios Api mod is also installed, the Exp Storage Book Auto-Store function can work from any Curios slot.

## Exp Hypercube:
Has a storage capacity of 2.1 billion mB (≈100 million XP).
Retains stored experience when broken. Allows storing/withdrawing experience in increments of 1, 10, or 100 levels.
## Exp Collector:
Functions the same as the Exp Hypercube, but can automatically absorb experience orbs within range, with an adjustable radius from 1 to 10 blocks.
## Exp Generator (Experimental):
Consumes stored experience to generate power at a rate of 512 FE/XP/tick.
